_comment: Streaming/viewing options a user can 'buy'. Prices in USD/month as of June 2026 — re-verify before launch, these change often. monthly_price 0 = free. special_rules flags services whose availability depends on user location.

services.name: TV Antenna (free over-the-air)
services.special_rules: Requires one-time antenna purchase (~$25). Picks up local OTA affiliates (ABC, CBS, NBC, ION) — availability/reception varies by market.

services.name: Sling Freestream
services.special_rules: Free ad-supported tier. Carries ION live; Friday WNBA games are regionalized by market.

services.name: WNBA League Pass
services.special_rules: OUT-OF-MARKET ONLY for live games. Blacked out: (1) games in the user's local team market, (2) all nationally televised games (ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, CBS, CBSSN, Disney+, Prime Video, NBA TV, NBC, Peacock, USA Network). Blacked-out games available on demand next day 6AM ET.

services.name: Paramount+ Essential
services.special_rules: Essential tier carries the WNBA-on-CBS games. The $12.99 tier adds live local CBS station.

services.name: Amazon Prime Video
services.special_rules: Standalone Prime Video price; also included with full Amazon Prime ($14.99/mo).

services.name: ESPN Unlimited (DTC)
services.special_rules: Includes ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPN-on-ABC games via the ESPN app.

services.name: YouTube TV
services.special_rules: Promo pricing often available for first months. Local affiliates (ABC/CBS/NBC) depend on user market.

services.name: Fubo Pro
services.special_rules: First-month promo ~$48.99. VERIFY NBC/USA carriage before relying on it — sources list ABC, ESPN, ION, CBS, CBSSN, NBA TV.

services.name: DirecTV MyEntertainment
services.special_rules: Genre-pack tier (~40 channels) that includes ION. Full Entertainment package ($89.99) adds ESPN, USA, NBC, etc.
